rubric.role_summary: Senior K–12 account executive selling learning software and services to school districts, responsible for new business, account expansion, pipeline development, and closing deals across an assigned territory.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior K–12 account executive selling learning software and services to school districts, responsible for new business, account expansion, pipeline development, and closing deals across an assigned territory.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 5+ years of proven sales experience.
- Experience with enterprise-level software sales and services.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Sales experience within EdTech or SaaS solution sales.
- Understanding of educational pedagogy and the dynamics of selling an LMS.
- Ability to sell at all levels, including C-suite and executive leadership.
- Strategic and consultative sales skills.
- Ability to conduct needs analyses and develop tailored proposals.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): United States. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
